verdict.rationale: Square is a commerce and payments platform that holds seller and customer data, so asking about an AI-training opt-out is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on AI model training, data-use opt-outs, or related privacy controls. The generic line about managing customer data securely is a different capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
